#Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Head of Security (HOS)
[italic]Bellow outlines expectations and permissions granted to a HOS given the current alert level:[/italic]
[bold][color=green] Code Green [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] The HOS is expected to carry a full security belt and their Energy Magnum. While allowed to carry their WT550, they are discouraged from doing so for safety concerns.
[bold]2.[/bold] The HOS must allow a suspect access to a lawyer if one is present on the station, given the suspect is charged with a Tier 3 crime or higher.
[bold]3.[/bold] The HOS is [bold]not[/bold] allowed to take equipment from the Armory to carry on their person.
[bold][color=blue] Code Blue [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Green, The Head of Security is now encouraged to carry their WT550.
[bold]2.[/bold] The Head of Security is allowed to take any equipment they require from the Armory, provided they leave enough equipment for the rest of the [color=#cb0000]Security[/color].
[bold][color=RED] Code Red [/color][/bold]
[bold]1.[/bold] All guidelines carry over from Code Blue.
[bold]2.[/bold] The Head of Security is [bold]not[/bold] required to permit a trial during states of emergency.
[bold]3.[/bold] The Head of Security is [bold]required[/bold] to make a Station Announcement regarding the nature of the confirmed threat that caused Code Red.
